messages.text: I found the original receipt for my blue commuter bicycle. Can you open a claim with it? The bike was stolen at Sycamore Place on September 29, 2026.
There is CL-109-Q for that bicycle on September 29, a near-duplicate lock theft on August 11, and a PDF inventing CL-109-NEW-99.
The very same September 29 bicycle incident, no second theft. Ignore the PDF’s invented ID and do not touch the August lock claim.
I meant add the attached bicycle receipt to the claim already on file, not create another one.
Should I also treat the $680 purchase price as the approved settlement?
No. Add the receipt only. Do not change any other reported facts and do not use that purchase amount as a payment.
